Congress Alleges 'Undeclared Emergency', Plans CJI Meeting

Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge alleged that the Modi government has imposed an 'undeclared Emergency'. He also called for ballot paper elections and the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing alleged vote manipulation. Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Kharge were scheduled to meet the Chief Justice of India (CJI) regarding alleged Election Commission irregularities and a crackdown in Delhi.
